location_description:
Jasmine Estates is a census-designated place (CDP) in Pasco County, Florida, United States.  The population was 18,989 according to the 2010 census.


== Geography ==
Jasmine Estates is located at 28°17′37″N 82°41′30″W.According to the United States Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of 3.6 square miles (9.3 km2), of which 3.6 square miles (9.3 km2) is land and 0.1 square miles (0.26 km2) (1.65%) is water.
